title: HAX properties locale overlay
description: Translation overlay stored as `locales/<tag>.<lang>.haxProperties.json` next to an element. HaxStore.attemptGizmoTranslation merges it over the base haxProperties: `gizmo` keys are replaced; `settings.configure` / `settings.advanced` and `demoSchema` are merged BY ARRAY INDEX, so entries must stay in the same order as the base file (use `{}` to skip an entry). `settings.developer` is not translated.

properties.description: Translated user-visible property values, keyed like the base demo.

translatedFields.description: Same length and order as the base group. Only user-visible strings belong here.
